\[

strategies.title: [exact-jacobian-sqp-polish] Analytic-gradient final KKT polish

strategies.title: [local-contact-graph-solve] Enumerated seven-disk contact-star replacement

Hard validity is preserved because equality solutions are accepted only after the frozen-exterior inequality solve, then the unrestricted inequality solve, then `_sanitize`; failed residual solves are discarded without changing the incumbent.

strategies.title: [rigidity-mode-nullspace] Active-framework nullspace displacement refinement
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: rigidity-mode-nullspace

Replacement scope: Replace the current `homotopy_edges` release loop and its three-stage contact-opening continuation inside `construct_packing`; retain the ordinary joint SLSQP result and all final `_sanitize` handling.

Compute budget: At most 3 incumbent-derived starts; for each, one sparse singular-value decomposition of the active-contact rigidity matrix and at most 4 bounded SLSQP solves of 180 iterations each. Expected evaluation-time effect: lower than the present release-loop plus Delaunay-cavity section, because it avoids repeated contact-graph continuation solves.

Gain mechanism: The incumbent selects a single active edge to release, but it does not identify coordinated first-order motions that preserve most active contacts while enlarging several bottleneck gaps simultaneously. Construct the rigidity matrix using signed pair-distance derivatives for contacts with gap at most `3e-5` and signed wall normals for wall contacts. Compute the smallest nontrivial right singular vectors after removing the three rigid-body-like directions prohibited by the square walls. For each of the leading two feasible modes, perturb centers by both signs with amplitude `0.0015`, recompute optimal fixed-center LP radii, and jointly polish. Add a temporary constraint requiring the weighted sum of gaps on formerly active contacts to increase by `2e-5`, excluding the one or two contacts with the largest unfavorable mode derivative; then remove that temporary constraint in a final joint SLSQP solve. This searches a mechanically meaningful escape direction rather than an arbitrary released edge. Every trial starts from LP-feasible radii, uses all wall and squared pair inequalities during polishing, and is finally passed through `_sanitize`.

Expected-gain check: this is accepted only if the evaluator reports raw `sum_radii > 2.63303412892`, and it is falsifiable because the new signed nullspace displacement is a coordinated active-framework motion not generated by the incumbent’s one-edge release ordering.

strategies.title: [weighted-voronoi-strip-reallocation] Power-cell strip replacement across a bott
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: weighted-voronoi-strip-reallocation

Replacement scope: Replace both the existing horizontal separator-patch reconstruction block and the subsequent Delaunay-cavity reconstruction block, beginning at `base = np.asarray(result.x, ...)` and ending immediately before candidate scoring.

Compute budget: At most 2 watershed strips per polished seed, each with one frozen-exterior SLSQP solve of 360 iterations and one released global SLSQP solve of 260 iterations; process at most the best 2 ranked seeds. Expected evaluation-time effect: approximately neutral to moderately lower than the current separator plus six-cavity loops.

Gain mechanism: Instead of choosing a strip solely from a gap in sorted `y` coordinates, form additive weighted Voronoi/power ownership using the incumbent disks: assign a fine deterministic `31 x 31` grid of square sample sites to the circle minimizing `||x-c_i||^2-r_i^2`. Identify the largest connected band of sites whose nearest-owner labels alternate between circles predominantly above and below a candidate horizontal or vertical watershed. The circles owning that band and their immediate Delaunay neighbors form a 9–13 circle replacement subsystem. Freeze the exterior disks, optimize subsystem centers and radii, and add a strip-width variable `w` constrained by the minimum signed distance between the two owner groups; maximize subsystem radius sum plus `0.03*w`. The width term explicitly reallocates residual void between rows rather than merely moving selected nearby disks. Release all circles for the final ordinary sum-radius solve. Frozen-exterior pair constraints, walls, all internal pairs, and final sanitization preserve validity.

Expected-gain check: this is accepted only if raw `sum_radii > 2.63303412892`; the falsifiable new freedom is reassignment of a measured weighted-Voronoi watershed’s void to both adjacent disk layers, whereas the incumbent’s separator selection uses only center-height gaps and cannot target an oblique or vertically oriented ownership bottleneck.

strategies.title: [mirror-fundamental-domain] Reflected half-square crystal search with intentiona
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: mirror-fundamental-domain

Gain mechanism: Build 13 centers in the left half-square `0 <= x <= 0.5`, reflect them across `x=0.5`, and thereby obtain 26 disks with paired radii. During half-domain optimization include ordinary walls, original-half pair constraints, reflected-image pair constraints, and seam constraints `0.5-x_i >= r_i`; optimize the 13 radii sum and double it. Generate four variants by reversing vertical phase and by adding one controlled `0.015` shear to alternating bands. Then break reflection symmetry by perturbing paired centers in opposite directions by `5e-4`, recompute LP radii, and use the existing unrestricted full SLSQP polish. This creates a qualitatively different boundary contact topology with paired seam contacts and efficient matched boundary chains; unrestricted polishing may retain only the useful asymmetric defect. All reflected seeds satisfy image constraints before full polishing, and all final candidates are checked by `_sanitize`.

Expected-gain check: this is accepted only if raw `sum_radii > 2.63303412892`; the threshold is falsifiable, and the explicit new degree of freedom is the reflected-image seam-contact topology, which is absent from the incumbent’s unrestricted stochastic row seeds and therefore is not deliberately sampled there.
